# Arterial and transcutaneous CO2 agreement

Compare Conway's published limits, corrected legacy limits and the new future-setting predictive interval for overall, ICU, acute respiratory failure and lung-function studies.
Method: future_setting_joint_v1. Public research candidates awaiting independent biostatistical review.
Default: signed arterial minus transcutaneous disagreement in mmHg for one observation in a new comparable setting.
Conditional inference: PaCO2 given observed TcCO2 requires an explicit local CSV/XLSX fixed empirical prior. The threshold probability includes equality.
No backend, telemetry, prior distribution in staged assets, or patient-value URLs. Legacy bootstrap and custom-study analysis are offline.
Source and methods: https://github.com/reblocke/tcco2-accuracy
